title: Add Use, Security, And Accountability
rule_summary: Massachusetts pharmacies using automated dispensing devices must follow the current Board/DCP policy governing facility approval, pharmacy ownership of stock, patient-specific authorization, records, packaging, loss accountability, and retail emergency-versus-routine controls.
exam_relevance: Tests a distinct pharmacist decision path using current official authority rather than rote trivia.
verification_notes: Authoring-session current official-source verification on 2026-08-14; requires fresh independent audit before release.
